full_details: He called from his own shop. The chronicle is in daily use and in excellent health. The cat reads only the second volume. He let that go. Sunday, after sermon, Jacqueline has a hen, and he will read the comedy with the door shut if the book-keeper will loose it. He cannot come to hear it. Garnish keeps the book through Thursday. You left before two. You did not cure the uncles. The Rose's title for the day stayed a bill.
one_sentence: Field asked after six weeks of Holinshed, set a hen for Sunday, and you came home to the king.
title: A hen for Sunday, the cat, and home to the king
